description: Searchable select — the ARIA combobox pattern (input + listbox), for when a plain <Select> has too many options to scan. Type to filter, Arrow keys to move, Enter to pick, Escape to close. `multiple` turns it into a token input where picks render as removable <Tag>s and the list stays open. Copy: the empty label says what was searched for and offers the way out — "No supplier matches 'nortwind'. Check the spelling, or add a supplier." A bare "No results" leaves the reader stuck on their own typo.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the text field.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select: `value` is an array and picks render as removable tags. Single (default): `value` is one option value.

props.name: value
props.description: One value in single mode, an array in multi mode.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives one value in single mode, the full array in multi mode. Pass the handler that matches your `multiple` setting.

props.name: filter
props.description: Matched against the option label, case-insensitive, by default. Pass a custom matcher to search other fields or fuzzy-match.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when the query matches nothing. Default "No matches".

props.name: size
props.description: sm / md (default) / lg — matches the shared control height/padding scale.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which surface the field sits on. On `muted` (a page/PageHeader) the border is dropped since the white fill separates it; `base` (default, a white card or form) keeps the border. Invalid + focus stay visible on both.
